newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines re-offers termed reverse repos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines re-offers termed reverse repos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it was re-offering its termed reverse repos to financial institutions two days after they were withdrawn.
The Central Bank quoted its one-month reverse repos at 10.750 percent, two-month reverse repos at 10.875 percent and the three-month reverse repos at 11.0 percent.
The interest rates were unchanged from the levels on Tuesday when the reverse repose were withdrawn.
The withdrawal spurred mild and short-lived buying of dollars in the foreign exchange market, as banks were left with excess funds but limited investment options.
